definitions.gloss: back side; rear part; the back
definitions.explanation: The rear-facing part or side of an object, building, body, or area. Used to specify spatial orientation.

examples.japanese: {後|うし}ろ{側|がわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: To go around to the back.
There's a scratch on the back of the car.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{後|うし}ろ{側|がわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{空|あ}いている→空く：11062_aku⟧。
examples.english: The seats at the back of the venue are still available.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧ (behind, back) and ⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ (side). Part of the directional ⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ series along with ⟦{前側|まえがわ}→前側：20171_maegawa⟧ (front side), ⟦{右側|みぎがわ}→右側：24189_migigawa⟧ (right side), ⟦{左側|ひだりがわ}→左側：22836_hidarigawa⟧ (left side).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後|うし}ろ{側|がわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧ — back seat
- {後|うし}ろ{側|がわ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ — to look from behind
- ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{後|うし}ろ{側|がわ} — the back of a building

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{背面|はいめん}→背面：20610_haimen⟧ — back surface, rear (more formal/technical)
- ⟦{裏側|うらがわ}→裏側：03042_uragawa⟧ — reverse side, back side (for flat objects, or hidden side)
- ⟦{前側|まえがわ}→前側：20171_maegawa⟧ — front side (antonym)
